entries.text: Ugh. Is this really how it’s gonna end? What a\nhassle...[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: ajito_honoo_040_honooboss_00

entries.text: About a year and a half ago...
entries.label: ajito_honoo_040_system_01

entries.text: Man, what a hassle... Pulled it off just in time.[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: ajito_honoo_040_honooboss_01

entries.text: Welcome back, Mellie![VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: ajito_honoo_040_kakutouboss_01

entries.text: I managed to get a buncha Charcadet to evolve.[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: ajito_honoo_040_honooboss_02

entries.text: That oughta be enough to power the Starmobile\nand finally get that hunka metal rollin’.[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: ajito_honoo_040_honooboss_03

entries.text: Glad tidings indeed. Is it not so, Ortega?[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: ajito_honoo_040_dokuboss_01

entries.text: I’m just surprised she’s not all hot air...[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: ajito_honoo_040_fairyboss_01

entries.text: Oh, shut it with the snide comments! You can be\nsuch an annoyin’ twerp, you know that?[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: ajito_honoo_040_honooboss_04

entries.text: As if you’re any better, Mela...[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: ajito_honoo_040_fairyboss_02

entries.text: Being rude and saying mean things is literally\nyour whole deal.[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: ajito_honoo_040_fairyboss_03

entries.text: That’s not true, Ortie.[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: ajito_honoo_040_kakutouboss_02

entries.text: The girls at the academy have always been\njealous of how cute Mellie is. She just puts on\r\na surly attitude so they’ll stop picking on her.[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: ajito_honoo_040_kakutouboss_03

entries.text: Although...I guess you’re not wrong to say that\nher surly attitude is what people know her for...[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: ajito_honoo_040_kakutouboss_04

entries.text: What?! Come on—not you too, Eri![VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: ajito_honoo_040_honooboss_05

entries.text: How ’bout we leave it at that, folks? It’s almost\ntime for the big event.[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: ajito_honoo_040_akuboss_01

entries.text: Yes, Operation Star... It’s finally happening.[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: ajito_honoo_040_kakutouboss_06

entries.text: And the big boss? What, pray, is their plan?[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: ajito_honoo_040_dokuboss_02

entries.text: They already got in touch with all the bullies and\nasked ’em to head over to the schoolyard.[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: ajito_honoo_040_akuboss_02

entries.text: It’s finally time, huh... Man, I’m so stoked!\nThe thrill’s burnin’ me right up![VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: ajito_honoo_040_honooboss_06

entries.text: I burned through everythin’ I had...and now I’ve\nsputtered out.[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: ajito_honoo_040_honooboss_07

entries.text: Guess this is where it ends...[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: ajito_honoo_040_honooboss_08

entries.text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]That [VAR 0x0101(0001)] of yours really let us\nhave it.[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: ajito_honoo_040_honooboss_09

entries.text: Beatin’ me in battle is a huge deal. So here—take\nthis Star Badge and be proud of yourself![VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: ajito_honoo_040_honooboss_10

entries.text: While I’m at it, you can have this TM too.\nNot like I’m gonna use it.[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: ajito_honoo_040_waza_01

entries.text: Lemme make one thing clear—I’m not givin’ these\nto YOU...[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: ajito_honoo_040_honooboss_11

entries.text: I’m givin’ them to your [VAR 0x0101(0001)].[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: ajito_honoo_040_honooboss_12

entries.text: You got what you came for. Now leave me alone.[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: ajito_honoo_040_honooboss_13

entries.text: You’re Mela from Team Star, right? There’s a\nPokémon I’d like you to see.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: ajito_honoo_040_nelke_01

entries.text: Huh? Who are you s’posed to be?[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: ajito_honoo_040_honooboss_14

entries.text: [EMPTY 64]
entries.label: ajito_honoo_040_nelke_02

entries.text: Fwoo!
entries.label: ajito_honoo_040_poke_01

entries.text: [EMPTY 64]
entries.label: ajito_honoo_040_nelke_03

entries.text: A Charcadet? Wait...[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: ajito_honoo_040_honooboss_15

entries.text: Foo-foom!
entries.label: ajito_honoo_040_poke_02

entries.text: Well, if it ain’t Charlos! What’re you doin’ here?[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: ajito_honoo_040_honooboss_16

entries.text: [EMPTY 64]
entries.label: ajito_honoo_040_poke_03

entries.text: It seems he came to this base looking for you.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: ajito_honoo_040_nelke_04

entries.text: Fwoo!
entries.label: ajito_honoo_040_poke_04

entries.text: You did...?[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: ajito_honoo_040_honooboss_17

entries.text: He’s very attached to you, isn’t he?[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: ajito_honoo_040_nelke_05

entries.text: [EMPTY 64]
entries.label: ajito_honoo_040_honooboss_18

entries.text: Yeah, ’cause I used to play with him every day\nback when I was still goin’ to school...[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: ajito_honoo_040_honooboss_19

entries.text: I can even tell more or less what he’s thinkin’ just\nby lookin’ at the way his flames move.[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: ajito_honoo_040_honooboss_20

entries.text: Do you have any idea why Charlos wanted to\nvisit you...?[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: ajito_honoo_040_nelke_06

entries.text: Foo-foom!
entries.label: ajito_honoo_040_poke_05

entries.text: Foo-foooooom!!!
entries.label: ajito_honoo_040_poke_06

entries.text: Charlos...[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: ajito_honoo_040_honooboss_22

entries.text: To me, it looks like he’s saying that he wants you\nto come back...[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: ajito_honoo_040_nelke_07

entries.text: Just shut it already, would ya?[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: ajito_honoo_040_honooboss_23

entries.text: [EMPTY 64]
entries.label: ajito_honoo_040_nelke_08

entries.text: [EMPTY 64]
entries.label: ajito_honoo_040_honooboss_24

entries.text: They say Team Star has holed itself up in these\nbases to plot something against the academy.\r\nWere you aware of this?[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: ajito_honoo_040_nelke_09

entries.text: First I’ve heard of a stupid rumor like that.\c\nMan, nothin’s changed since back then...\nEveryone’s still spoutin’ garbage.[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: ajito_honoo_040_honooboss_25

entries.text: [EMPTY 64]
entries.label: ajito_honoo_040_nelke_10

entries.text: Then what about that modified car you were\nmotoring around in just now?[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: ajito_honoo_040_nelke_11

entries.text: The Starmobile? We made that thing a long time\nago to help us out with a big fight.[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: ajito_honoo_040_honooboss_26

entries.text: But we never actually used it against anyone\nbefore you two came lookin’ for trouble.[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: ajito_honoo_040_honooboss_27

entries.text: You never...used it before? And what’s this about\na big fight?[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: ajito_honoo_040_nelke_12

entries.text: You ever heard of Operation Star?[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: ajito_honoo_040_honooboss_28

entries.text: Operation Star...? Not Operation Starfall?\c\nNo, this is the first I’m hearing of it.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: ajito_honoo_040_nelke_13

entries.text: Huh. Yeah, I guess you wouldn’t know...[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: ajito_honoo_040_honooboss_29

entries.text: But for me and the rest of Team Star, it’s a\nmemory we’ll always treasure.[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: ajito_honoo_040_honooboss_30
